result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same landscape code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options, and `updateLandscape` still works. The `cli` module compiles. I did not run any tests, and I did not run either command end to end.

- **Dispatch:** `CommandLineInterface.java` routes `analyzeLandscape` to the same method as `updateLandscape`. `-help` prints the usage for whichever name was typed.
- **Constants and overview:** `Commands.java` has the new name and a description saying it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument overview lists both commands.
- **README:** it had no command section, so I added a "Command line commands" list covering `init`, `generateReports`, `analyzeLandscape`, `updateLandscape` and `updateConfig`.
